persona: Buyer for an online t-shirt shop

designs.title: Playa Venao
designs.why: Looks good as a thumbnail on both tees, but Venao is a small search term. Without a hook beyond 'surf town badge', it relies on people who have been there, which is a narrow market at $50.
designs.fix: Add a stronger destination cue in the copy (e.g. 'Los Santos, Panama' or 'Pacific Coast'). It helps search and makes the shirt feel worth $50.

designs.title: San Juan del Sur
designs.why: SJdS is a well-known backpacker and surf stop, the Cristo makes it instantly recognisable in a product photo, and it reads cleanly on black and white. It's a likely steady seller.
designs.fix: Tighten the side-copy so the thumbnail stays legible; the small left text turns to grey noise at listing size.

designs.title: Haleiwa
designs.why: Hawaii and the North Shore carry the biggest audience of the three, so it's the best traffic driver. The mockups read crisply. The landmark error is a review risk, since Hawaii buyers will notice Diamond Head.
designs.fix: Fix the backdrop to a true North Shore view before launch to avoid 'that's not Haleiwa' reviews and returns.
